summary: Elevate your business operations with our specialized data analytics training program. Gain valuable insights for strategic decision-making.
lede: Data Analytics for Business Operations teaches you to turn data from ERP and CRM systems into practical insight for daily operations. Build a unified analytics framework through data cleaning, exploratory analysis, statistical modeling, and SQL-based querying, supported by Microsoft Power BI®. Apply these skills to demand forecasting, inventory optimization, lead-time reduction, quality monitoring, and resource utilization. With hands-on operational datasets, Balanced Scorecard reporting, and an overview of machine learning for anomaly detection, you will develop templates and frameworks to support proactive management despite data silos, legacy systems, and data quality challenges.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals who manage, analyze, or oversee the physical and digital workflows of a modern enterprise.
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of business operations or supply chain management. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (vlookups, pivot tables) is required. No prior experience with SQL or Power BI® is necessary, as introductory modules are included.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
